parameters.content:
## Finance_RAG_Agent (v2)

Runs monthly on day 1, 8am — after Finance_RAG_Ingestion has refreshed on day 28.

**v2 changes vs original:**
1. Added "Set Reporting Period" — computes the exact previous calendar month instead of a vague "this month" prompt, so the report always covers the correct period regardless of exactly when the trigger fires.
2. Added "Prepare Email" — defensively parses whichever field the Agent output lands in, strips stray Markdown fences, and falls back to <pre> wrapping if output isn't valid HTML. Protects against silent breakage if the Agent node's output field name ever changes.
3. System prompt now requires citing file_name + drive_url per claim, plus a final Sources section (relies on the matching v2 Ingestion workflow's new metadata fields).

Same credentials, index, and recipient as the original — this is a drop-in replacement.
